title: Frozen Pizza with Meat (no pepperoni), Medium Crust

content.title: About
content.content: This is a frozen pizza with a medium‑thick crust, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and a variety of meats except pepperoni (e.g., ham, chicken, beef). It is designed for quick oven preparation and retains the aroma and juiciness of the ingredients after heating.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Medium crust (3408) provides a balance between crunch and softness.
Freezing preserves the freshness of ingredients without the need for added preservatives.
Meat blends without pepperoni often use milder cuts, resulting in a less spicy flavor.
Tomatoes in the sauce are usually cooked, enhancing their natural sweetness.
The pizza is easy to prepare: preheat the oven to 200 °C and bake for 12‑15 minutes.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: The meat topping provides high‑quality protein essential for tissue repair and maintenance.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: Mozzarella cheese supplies calcium, supporting bone and dental health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Meat and tomato sauce contain vitamins B6 and B12, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Easily digestible carbohydrates
items.content: The dough offers a quick source of energy, especially useful before physical activity.

items.title: Iron content
items.content: Meat ingredients provide iron, which aids oxygen transport in the blood.

items.title: High sodium level
items.content: Salt in the sauce and cheese can raise blood pressure if consumed frequently.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Meat and cheese contain saturated fats, which should be limited in cardiovascular disease.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: People with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy should choose alternative options.

items.title: Gluten in the crust
items.content: The dough contains wheat, making it unsuitable for gluten‑free diets.

items.title: Need for thorough heating
items.content: Insufficiently heated pizza may retain bacteria, especially in the meat components.

content.title: How to Cook
content.content: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the pizza on a baking sheet or rack and bake for 12‑15 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is fully melted. Let it cool briefly before slicing.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen pizza at –18 °C or lower. After thawing, consume within 24 hours. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
